sourceRefs.locator: 序 (preface), arrival in 崇寧癸未 and flight after the war. 卷之四, 食店 (book IV, Restaurants), orders, bowls and wages. National Library of China, NLC892-411999008778-118945.
Kunstkamera 4 (30), pp. 6–15, especially pp. 6–8 on the preface, Meng’s arrival and his flight from Kaifeng in 1127. English abstract.

note.de: Meng kommt mit seiner Familie in die östliche Hauptstadt. Später erinnert er sich an die Speisehäuser und an die Kellner, die jede Schale dem richtigen Gast bringen mussten.
note.en: Meng comes with his family to the Eastern Capital. His later account remembers the restaurants and the servers who had to deliver every bowl to the right guest.
